title: उँगलियाँ चटकाने से आर्थराइटिस होता है? 🤞

shots.vo: एक डॉक्टर ने सिर्फ़ एक हाथ के नकल्स, साठ साल तक चटकाए, एक बहस ख़त्म करने के लिए।
shots.prompt: close-up of an older man's hands, the left one cracking its knuckles, warm light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Ek doctor ne sirf ek haath ke knuckles, saath saal tak chatkaye, ek behes khatam karne ke liye.

shots.vo: बचपन में डोनाल्ड अनगर को माँ और मौसियों ने डराया: नकल्स चटकाओगे तो आर्थराइटिस हो जाएगा।
shots.prompt: a 1930s kitchen where a mother scolds a boy cracking his knuckles, vintage painting style, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Bachpan mein Donald Unger ko maa aur massiyon ne daraya: knuckles chatkaoge to arthritis ho jayega.

shots.vo: तो उन्होंने एक एक्सपेरिमेंट किया। बाएँ हाथ के नकल्स रोज़ कम से कम दो बार चटकाए। दाएँ के कभी नहीं।
shots.prompt: a man in a lab coat comparing his left and right hands at a desk, close-up, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: To unhone ek experiment kiya. Left haath ke knuckles roz kam se kam do baar chatkaye. Right ke kabhi nahi.

shots.vo: साठ साल बाद जाँच की। आर्थराइटिस नहीं। किसी भी हाथ में नहीं।
shots.prompt: an x-ray style glowing image of two healthy human hands side by side, dark background, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Saath saal baad jaanch ki. Arthritis nahi. Kisi bhi haath mein nahi.

shots.vo: तो ये आवाज़ क्या है? जोड़ एक फ़्लूइड में रहते हैं। जोड़ खिंचता है, तो प्रेशर गिर जाता है।
shots.prompt: a glowing 3D illustration of a finger joint surrounded by fluid, medical style, dark background, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: To ye awaaz kya hai? Jod ek fluid mein rehte hain. Jod khinchta hai, to pressure gir jata hai.

shots.vo: उस फ़्लूइड में अचानक गैस का बबल बन जाता है। वही क्रैक की आवाज़ है जो आप सुनते हैं।
shots.prompt: macro of a bubble forming suddenly inside clear liquid, dramatic light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Us fluid mein achanak gas ka bubble ban jata hai. Wahi crack ki awaaz hai jo aap sunte hain.

shots.vo: आस-पास वालों के लिए irritating? शायद। नुक़सानदेह? शायद नहीं।
shots.prompt: a person cracking their knuckles at an office desk while a coworker winces, cinematic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Aas-paas walon ke liye irritating? Shayad. Nuksaandeh? Shayad nahi.
